text:
maya: Heads up — AWS reseller CloudChannelX submitted their month-end usage report for Apr. Partner PR-482 shows a 3.1x spike in marketplace metered units compared to our reconciled logs. Invoice attached but numbers don't line up. Can partner finance confirm the source of the spike?

sam: I pulled our ingestion logs, we don't see the extra tokens/units timestamps matching their report. Suspect duplicate reporting from their side (ingest/migration). Snapshot: 

```
partner_id,month,units_reported,units_reconciled
PR-482,2026-04,310000,98000
PR-482,2026-03,120000,118500
```

leah: Pinged our contact at CloudChannelX. They say they had an S3 replication job that retried and caused duplicate metering events for a 6-hour window on 2026-04-30. They acknowledged the error and said they'd issue a credit memo (CM) for the overstated usage, but no firm ETA — ops is on it.

jordan: If the CM is delayed beyond our close, do we want to post a provisional credit so we don't incorrectly recognize the extra revenue to PR-482? We should also flag revenue recognition implications.

sam: Estimated gross overstatement ~ $19,200 for Apr (list price). My recommendation: post a provisional credit (contra revenue) and tag it with GL 4-120 "Marketplace Adjustments" pending reversal when CM is received. Also set a ticket to reverse once CM posted. Anyone object?

maya: :thumbsup: agree. Please create the provisional JV and include a short memo referencing CloudChannelX CM pending. Use reason code "reseller_reporting_error". Jordan — can you approve the customer-impact note for contracts?

jordan: Approved. Also confirm whether we need to notify the partner management team / SDR for any customer comms.

leah: I'll draft a short partner-facing email once we have the JV number. CloudChannelX wants us to hold off public comms until they confirm timing.

maya: Draft email template (for records):

```
Subject: Follow-up on Apr marketplace usage for PR-482
Hi <Partner Contact>,

Thanks for the update. We've posted a provisional adjustment on our side pending your credit memo. Once we receive the CM referencing your invoice #CCX-2026-04-PR482 we'll reverse the provision and reconcile. Please send the CM PDF to billing@redwood.ai.

Best,
Maya (Finance)
```

billing-bot: Provisional JV created: JV-2026-0443, amount $19,200, GL 4-120, status: PENDING_REVERSAL. Ticket: FIN-4521.

sam: Filing note for month close. I'll attach the JV and our reconciliation snippet to the month-end pack.

maya: Thanks all. Leave this thread open until CM posted. :wave:
